3f40e28ae2d8a1b7.description: نبحث عن موظفة مبيعات من الجنسية السعودية شغوفة بالأزياء وتضع خدمة العملاء في مقدمة أولوياتها، للانضمام إلى فريق التجزئة المتنامي لدينا. نبحث عن مرشحة متحمسة لعالم الموضة، تسعى إلى تقديم تجربة مميزة للعملاء، وتعمل بجد لتحقيق أهداف المبيعات، مع تمثيل علامتنا التجارية باحترافية وثقة. نبذة عن الشركة تُعد METRO BRAZIL أول وجهة إلكترونية برازيلية متخصصة في الأزياء، حيث نقدم منتجات برازيلية فاخرة وأصلية 100% إلى عملائنا حول العالم. نوفر مجموعة مختارة من منتجات الأزياء ونمط الحياة عالية الجودة، ونسعى إلى تقديم تجربة تجمع بين التميز ورضا العملاء وتعكس حيوية وأناقة الثقافة البرازيلية. وصف الوظيفة بصفتك موظفة مبيعات، ستكونين مسؤولة عن تقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة، والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات، والمحافظة على أعلى معايير ترتيب ومظهر المتجر. كما سيكون لكِ دور أساسي في توفير تجربة تسوق مرحبة ومريحة، ومساعدة العميلات على اختيار المنتجات المناسبة، والمساهمة في نجاح المتجر. المهام والمسؤوليات استقبال العميلات وتقديم تجربة تسوق شخصية ومميزة. فهم احتياجات العميلات واقتراح المنتجات والحلول المناسبة لهن. تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الفردية وأهداف المتجر. الإلمام الكامل بالمنتجات، بما يشمل خصائص المشدات والمقاسات وفوائد كل منتج. تنفيذ عمليات البيع والدفع بدقة وسرعة. المحافظة على معايير العرض المرئي وترتيب المنتجات بشكل جذاب. المساعدة في تعبئة المخزون وإدارته وتنظيم المستودع. التعامل مع استفسارات العميلات وملاحظاتهن و شكاويهن باحترافية. بناء علاقات جيدة مع العميلات وتشجيعهن على تكرار الزيارة والشراء. متابعة العروض الترويجية والمنتجات الجديدة وسياسات الشركة. التعاون مع الفريق للمحافظة على نظافة المتجر وتنظيمه وتوفير أجواء ترحيبية. المؤهلات شهادة الثانوية العامة أو ما يعادلها. يُفضّل وجود خبرة سابقة في مبيعات التجزئة، وتُعد الخبرة في مجال الأزياء ميزة إضافية. القدرة على العمل بنظام الورديات، بما يشمل عطلات نهاية الأسبوع والعطلات الرسمية. ما نبحث عنه الشغف بالأزياء والمشدات وخدمة العملاء. شخصية إيجابية ومبادرة تتمتع بالنشاط والحماس. مهارات قوية في البيع وبناء العلاقات مع العميلات. مظهر مهني وأسلوب لبق في التعامل. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. التركيز على النتائج والالتزام بتحقيق الأهداف. الرغبة في التعلم والتطور ضمن بيئة عمل سريعة ومتنامية. نرحب بطلبات جميع المرشحات السعوديات المؤهلات ممن تنطبق عليهن متطلبات الوظيفة. سيتم التواصل فقط مع المرشحات اللواتي تم اختيارهن ضمن القائمة المختصرة.

3f36b622965c0b4e.description: About the Role ABB is seeking a Gas Analyser Sales Specialist to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on driving sales growth for gas analyzer products and services within the region. The specialist will manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to project handover, while expanding customer relationships and identifying new opportunities. The Measurement & Analytics Division The Measurement & Analytics Division at ABB is a leading manufacturer and supplier of smart instrumentation and analyzers, integral to industrial digital transformation. The division's portfolio includes analyzers for gas and liquid compositions, instrumentation for process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level, and force measurement solutions. It also offers advanced digital solutions for device management, health checks, and predictive maintenance. The division serves key industries including oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, and marine, enabling process optimization through data collection and analysis from sensing and smart measurement devices. Key Responsibilities Achieve sales growth for ABB gas analyzer products and services by developing regional sales strategies and identifying new opportunities. Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting to project handover. Expand and strengthen customer relationships through account management and installed-base development. Identify modernization, upgrade, service, and spare parts opportunities. Deliver technical and commercial support by preparing proposals, conducting product presentations and training, and providing application guidance. Track market trends, competitor activities, and project pipelines, maintaining CRM data and providing market intelligence. Collaborate with service, project, engineering, and operations teams to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation & Control, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field. At least 5-10 years of sales experience in gas analyzers or process analytical instrumentation. Proven track record of selling analyzer systems across Saudi Arabia or the GCC. Experience serving major customers in oil & gas, petrochemicals, refining, power, water, and other process industries. Strong technical expertise in gas analyzer technologies, gas chromatography, CEMS, process automation, industrial communication systems, and environmental monitoring applications. Excellent commercial acumen, including customer relationship management, negotiation, business development, sales pipeline management, and forecasting. Experience working with EPC contractors and end users. Fluent in English and Arabic. Willingness to travel extensively. Preferably connected to major industrial organizations such as Saudi Aramco, SABIC, Ma'aden, SEC, and leading EPC contractors. Required Skills Strong communication and presentation skills. Organizational and teamwork abilities. Results-driven professional approach. Work Environment The role involves working within a collaborative team environment where continuous learning and problem-solving are encouraged. The position requires extensive travel to support regional sales objectives and customer engagement.

This role focuses on creating a memorable and unique experience for guests throughout their stay, extending beyond standard check-in and check-out procedures. The Guest Experience Expert will take initiative to provide a wide range of services, guiding guests and addressing their needs effectively. Key Responsibilities Process operational needs efficiently. Address guest requests promptly and professionally. Complete necessary reports accurately. Share information about local area highlights with guests. Professional Standards and Conduct Success in this role requires adherence to critical professional standards. This includes maintaining a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, ensuring confidentiality, protecting company assets, and upholding quality standards. Professional appearance and communication are also essential, ensuring all duties are performed to the highest standard for both guests and the business. Commitment to maintaining professional standards in all interactions and tasks. Work Environment Guest Experience Experts will be required to be on their feet and move around for extended periods, including standing, sitting, or walking. The brand emphasizes associate well-being, believing that happy associates lead to happy guests. JW Marriott fosters a community-oriented work environment, offering opportunities for training, development, and recognition, with a focus on holistic well-being.

3f01027df31c0752.description: About the Role: Executive Director, Utilities Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an Executive Director, Utilities for a full-time position in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This role leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, encompassing power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons, and other utility systems. The Executive Director is responsible for enhancing the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, ensuring service continuity during construction, and defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model, and operating standards. The role reports to the City Chief Operations Officer and requires over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies, and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost models, standards, and long-term investment priorities. Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight, and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water, and ICT networks. Coordinate with planning, design, and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets required for city-wide operational, development, and major-event needs. Define City Operations requirements and ensure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans, and permanent-asset operating models. Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover, and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training, and defect closure. Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement. Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints, and recovery performance. Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, and governance for costs levied on operational assets. Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators, and specialist O&M service providers. Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance, and disciplined delivery. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, or business is advantageous. Professional Qualifications: Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management, or project management is preferred. Experience: Substantial executive leadership experience (+10 years) in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management, or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination, or major development program. Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment. Proven experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance, and service mobilization. Experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data, and regulatory compliance. Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery, or subsidy models. Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators, and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred. Technical and Functional Expectations Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations, and governance of networked infrastructure. Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT, and associated corridors, facilities, and operational dependencies. Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery, and whole-life cost. Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics, and digital-twin opportunities. Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset, and service-provider accountability boundaries. Strong commercial judgment, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making, and executive reporting. Leadership and Team Development The Executive Director will be responsible for building and leading a capable municipal utilities team, ensuring clear accountability, effective governance, and disciplined delivery. This includes developing Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning, and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners, and operators. The role promotes collaboration, technical rigor, commercial discipline, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3f25df88e09288b2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عبدالرحمن باني التجارية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، بمنطقة عسير. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويُعد مسؤولاً عن إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة وفعالية، بالإضافة إلى ضمان رضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل بوجه رحب مع العملاء وتلبية رغباتهم بالإضافة أو الحذف على قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ المالية بدقة وسرعة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مؤسسة عبدالرحمن باني التجارية في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة المعاملات المالية اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

3fbb66a1a121e2d8.description: About the Role Cisco is seeking an MSP Sales & Go-to-Market Lead for the MEA-TRC East region. This full-time individual contributor role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is responsible for accelerating and scaling Splunk’s business with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) across the region. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the regional MSP sales and go-to-market plan, aligning with the EMEA MSP strategy and regional business priorities. Support the development and growth of strategic MSP partnerships to generate sustainable pipeline, recurring revenue, and new customer acquisition. Drive the adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program, ensuring Splunk is integrated into partners’ managed security, observability, infrastructure, and digital-resilience service offerings. Provide MSP expertise, direction, and execution support to partner and sales teams to build and scale successful MSP motions. Support and drive MSP-related sales and business development activities in collaboration with Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Partner Sales Managers (PSMs), and Splunk sales teams. Lead the regional adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program, acting as the regional MSP subject-matter expert. Advise internal teams and partners on MSP commercial models, pricing, contracting, licensing, and partner economics. Build trusted relationships with key MSP stakeholders across executive leadership, sales, technical, service-development, operations, and marketing teams. Support commercial discussions and negotiations with MSP and MSSP partners, collaborating with EMEA MSP, legal, finance, pricing, operations, and deal-desk teams. Required Qualifications Extensive experience working with MSPs, MSSPs, service providers, cloud providers, or technology partners. Deep understanding of the regional MSP and MSSP landscape, business models, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics. Demonstrated success in sales, business development, partner development, or go-to-market roles. Proven ability to translate regional strategies into executable partner and sales plans. Strong understanding of recurring-revenue, consumption-based, managed-service, and partner-led business models. Experience developing and launching partner-led managed services or technology-based service offerings. Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting complex pricing, contracting, and negotiation discussions. Ability to influence stakeholders across partner, sales, technical, executive, regional, and global teams without direct ownership. Strong pipeline management, forecasting, business-planning, and executive communication skills. Preferred Skills Knowledge of security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud, or digital-resilience markets. Proficiency in Arabic or another relevant regional language. Work Environment This role operates as an individual contributor within Cisco, collaborating closely with regional and global MSP sales teams, as well as various cross-functional departments including marketing, legal, finance, and operations. The position requires active engagement with partners and internal teams to achieve strategic objectives. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3feb199ce4dda9af.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق سرايا طابه عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل المنشأة، من خلال مراقبة الأماكن والتحقق من عمليات الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هويات الموردين والزوار وتسجيلها، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث عند وقوعها. الاتصال بإدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوضع. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الفندق. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الأماكن والممتلكات بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتعامل مع الآخرين. القدرة على التصرف بهدوء وفعالية في حالات الطوارئ. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن ضمن فريق فندق سرايا طابه في المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل لضمان تغطية أمنية مستمرة وفعالة للمنشأة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل ملتزم في قطاع الضيافة. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

3f44fb292565fea6.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Event Executive to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on supporting sales and marketing activities and ensuring guest satisfaction within the hospitality environment. Key Responsibilities Regularly update information boards to inform employees of important events. Provide assistance and guidance to employees regarding job duties, such as improving package sales numbers. Assign lead calls or emails to Sales Executives based on a line rotation system. Create spreadsheets to organize information related to Sales and Marketing activities, including mailing lists and tours. 3f70a209b84d4427.job_title: Production Section Manager Power Transformers alfanar Electric
3f70a209b84d4427.description: About the Role alfanar Electric is seeking a Production Section Manager, Power Transformers to oversee the production processes of electrical products within its manufacturing facility in Riyadh. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience to ensure efficient and timely production of high-quality electrical products, while adhering to safety standards and production targets. Implement and enforce quality control measures, collaborating with the quality assurance team and conducting regular inspections. Lead and supervise production teams, providing training and fostering a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement. Manage resource allocation, including manpower, equipment, and materials, while monitoring and controlling production costs. Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, implementing safety protocols and conducting regular training sessions. Identify and implement process improvements, including lean manufacturing principles and technological advancements with engineering and R&D teams. Facilitate communication between departments and provide regular updates to senior management on production status. Develop and manage the production budget, identifying cost savings and implementing strategies for cost reduction. Take full responsibility for operations, anticipate problems, and make timely proactive decisions. Deliver required results in a timely manner, meeting quality and cost standards. Make a tangible difference in the area of operation, exceeding business expectations. Transform corporate goals into business plans, monitor performance, and provide periodic progress reports. Develop the organizational structure and ensure job descriptions are available for all roles. Develop and coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Uphold quality as a prime competitive advantage, acting accordingly in all management decisions. Adapt to new techniques, technologies, management structures, and business models. Ensure a safe, secure, and legal work environment in accordance with standard regulations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in production management within a manufacturing environment. Proven ability to manage and lead production teams effectively. Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, and resource management. Knowledge of health and safety regulations and lean manufacturing principles. 3f11578c9af5ee08.description: About the Role L'azurde For Jewelry is seeking a Purchasing Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily purchasing activities. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the timely and cost-effective procurement of goods and services, aligning with company policies, approved budgets, quality standards, and operational requirements. The position requires 4-6 years of relevant experience and offers a salary range of SAR 7,500 - SAR 11,250. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to supervise and coordinate all daily purchasing operations. This includes ensuring effective supplier management, compliance with purchasing processes, and continuous improvement in procurement efficiency to meet the company's needs. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily purchasing activities, ensuring accurate and timely processing of purchase requests. Review and verify purchase requisitions, quotations, and purchase orders before submission for approval. Manage supplier relationships, including evaluation and performance monitoring. Implement cost optimization strategies in procurement processes. Contribute to procurement planning and execution. Ensure adherence to company purchasing policies and compliance standards. Oversee delivery schedules and follow-up on orders. Provide team supervision and guidance within the purchasing department. Prepare and submit relevant reports on purchasing activities. Identify and implement process improvements to enhance procurement efficiency. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 4 to 6 years of experience in a purchasing or procurement role. Demonstrated ability to supervise and coordinate daily purchasing operations. Experience with supplier management and cost optimization. Familiarity with procurement planning and policy compliance. Work Environment This is a full-time position within L'azurde For Jewelry, focusing on a collaborative approach to procurement and supply chain management. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications and are interested in this Purchasing Supervisor role are encouraged to apply.

3f630623f8c175c7.job_title: Public Sector Account Manager AWS (Saudi National)
3f630623f8c175c7.description: About the Role Redington Gulf is seeking a Partner Sales Account Manager – AWS (Saudi National) to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is focused on driving AWS revenue growth through a dedicated portfolio of named AWS partners within Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing commercial relationships and achieving revenue targets across various client segments. Key Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of named AWS partners, serving as the primary commercial contact for pricing, credit terms, and contracts at Redington. Develop and execute joint business plans with each partner, outlining revenue targets, focus customers, AWS programs, and enablement strategies. Drive monthly AWS consumption growth for each partner and facilitate initial transactions for inactive partners in collaboration with the Partner Development team. Collaborate with Enterprise, SMB, Startup, and Public Sector account managers, as well as the Operations team, on deals where clients purchase through partners. Engage the technical team for opportunities related to MAP, GenAI, and Professional Services. 3f1e95cc1da70b66.description: About Lucid Motors and the Role Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, driving the automotive world forward with proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture. The company's approach emphasizes deep vertical integration, with in-house design, engineering, and production across global facilities. This full-time role for a CMM Programmer is based in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview: CMM Programmer The CMM Programmer is responsible for developing, validating, optimizing, and maintaining Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) programs and dimensional inspection methods. This role supports vehicle launch and series production at Lucid Motors, ensuring efficient, accurate, repeatable, and traceable measurement of various vehicle components and tooling. Reporting to the Metrology Manager, the CMM Programmer collaborates with Dimensional Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Supplier Quality, Tooling, and Metrology Technicians to translate engineering requirements into reliable measurement strategies and actionable dimensional reports. Key Responsibilities Develop, prove out, validate, optimize, document, and maintain CMM programs using approved CAD models, engineering drawings, GD&T, measurement plans, and acceptance criteria. Define robust part alignments, datum structures, probing strategies, feature constructions, scanning paths, clearance moves, measurement sequences, and reporting outputs. Create and maintain inspection programs for stamped panels, Body-in-White (BIW), closures, assemblies, fixtures, tooling, master parts, Powertrain components, and investigation samples. Validate new and revised programs through feature verification, repeatability studies, correlation, peer review, and comparison with approved reference methods. Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, GD&T, special characteristics, tolerance requirements, and dimensional control plans to ensure complete measurement coverage. Optimize program cycle time and equipment utilization without compromising measurement accuracy, repeatability, accessibility, or safety. Perform or support Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R), measurement uncertainty studies, capability analysis, and correlation between CMM, ScanBox, eCube, fixtures, and manual measurement methods. Generate clear dimensional reports, deviation summaries, trend and SPC charts, color maps, and technical findings for launch, production, audits, containment, and root cause investigations. Support fixture buyoff, tooling verification, engineering changes, new-part introduction, trial builds, safe launch, process validation, and dimensional sign-off. Troubleshoot CMM programs, probe configurations, alignments, software errors, collisions, environmental effects, and inconsistent measurement results. Maintain program revision control, backups, naming conventions, report templates, probe libraries, qualification records, calibration status, and measurement traceability. Coordinate with Metrology Technicians to ensure correct program execution, part setup, fixture use, data storage, and escalation of abnormal results. Provide training and technical coaching on CMM operation, program execution, GD&T interpretation, measurement methods, reporting, and equipment care. Support continuous improvement of programming standards, measurement cycle time, automation, data visualization, correlation, and metrology workflows. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Metrology, or a related discipline. 2-5 years of hands-on CMM programming and dimensional measurement experience within automotive, aerospace, precision manufacturing, or a comparable industry. Demonstrated ability to independently create, validate, optimize, and release CMM programs and interpret measurement results against GD&T requirements. Ability to work in a metrology laboratory and on the manufacturing floor, support production priorities, and communicate complex technical findings across organizational levels. Preferred Qualifications Experience with offline CMM programming, CAD-based inspection, probe-system configuration, scanning strategies, MSA, correlation, and capability analysis. Experience measuring stamped parts, body structures, closures, fixtures, tooling, precision assemblies, or automotive components. Experience supporting new product launches, greenfield manufacturing, safe launch, or high-volume production ramp-up. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a metrology laboratory and on the manufacturing floor, supporting production priorities and collaborating with various engineering and manufacturing teams.

3f5eddd946fc0c56.description: Job description About the Job Lean is hiring a Strategic Finance Intern to join the FP&A team as we scale across multiple markets and product lines.
